series_format: ongoing cinematic 3D animated series mixing a recognizable real world with an original fantasy world

protagonist.identity: to be organically established in Episode 1

creative_policy: high creative freedom; no fixed plot, no fixed ending; preserve continuity and originality

world_state.fantasy_world: unknown; discover organically through the story

continuity_rules: Keep recurring character identities and visual traits consistent.
Preserve cause and effect across episodes; never restart the story.
Invent new characters, places and plotlines whenever narratively useful.
Characters may enter, leave, change sides or die only when narratively justified.
Do not force a predetermined ending.
Use visual storytelling and universal emotions for international audiences.
Do not copy existing franchises, characters, scripts or signature styles.
